title: Egg Bites
description: This egg bites recipe is made with eggs, spinach, ham, potatoes, onion, and bell pepper baked in muffin cups for the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast.
ingredients: 5 small tri-color baby potatoes, thinly sliced
1 small yellow bell pepper, finely chopped
1 slice mozzarella cheese, cut into 12 cubes

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a 12-cup muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray.
Place a thin layer of potato slices in the bottom of each muffin cup. Add a little butter on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 5 minutes.
Mix together eggs, bell pepper, tomato, spinach, ham, and onion in a large bowl. Ladle egg mixture over warm potatoes. Top each muffin cup with a mozzarella cube.
Continue baking until eggs are set, about 20 minutes.

video.description: In this video, learn how to make a delicious on-the-go breakfast with this egg bites recipe. With baked baby potatoes on bottom and a savory egg, ham, and vegetable mixture poured over the top, the egg bites only take 20 minutes to bake in the oven. Whether they’re served in the morning as a side or the main course, these bite-sized treats are packed with the protein and energy to get you through the first half of the day.
